component.name: Glafka
component.summary: A lightweight GNOME-native ebook library manager

description.p: Glafka keeps your ebooks in one tidy library on your computer and gets them onto your e-reader, by USB or by email. It needs no Calibre, but can import a Calibre library.

ul.li: Import EPUB and PDF files, whole folders, or a Calibre library
Browse by author, series and tag; edit details and covers
Copy books to a USB e-reader or email them, and see which are on it
Book details: the cover follows edits right away, also a generated cover's title and author
Book details: going back to the original description after a save is kept

description.p: See what was sent where and when.

ul.li: History page: every copy to a reader, email, deletion from a reader and "mark as removed", by day, with a filter for emailed books
Each book's own history in its details

description.p: The library database is upgraded on first start; older versions cannot open it after that.
